parameters.query:
INSERT INTO loan_products
  (source, product_name, provider, interest_rate, min_monthly_income, min_credit_score, max_credit_score,
   min_age, max_age, allowed_employment, eligibility_text, source_url, is_active, last_seen_at)
SELECT $2, x.product_name, x.provider, x.interest_rate, x.min_monthly_income, x.min_credit_score, x.max_credit_score,
       x.min_age, x.max_age,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.allowed_employment,'') = '' THEN NULL ELSE string_to_array(x.allowed_employment, ',') END,
       x.eligibility_text, $3, true, now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(product_name text, provider text, interest_rate numeric,
     min_monthly_income numeric, min_credit_score int, max_credit_score int, min_age int, max_age int,
     allowed_employment text, eligibility_text text)
ON CONFLICT (source, product_name) DO UPDATE SET
  provider = EXCLUDED.provider, interest_rate = EXCLUDED.interest_rate,
  min_monthly_income = EXCLUDED.min_monthly_income, min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
  max_credit_score = EXCLUDED.max_credit_score, min_age = EXCLUDED.min_age, max_age = EXCLUDED.max_age,
  allowed_employment = EXCLUDED.allowed_employment, eligibility_text = EXCLUDED.eligibility_text,
  source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, is_active = true, last_seen_at = now()
RETURNING product_id;
UPDATE loan_products SET is_active = false WHERE last_seen_at < now() - interval '3 days' RETURNING product_id;

parameters.content:
**Workflow A - Loan product discovery**

Schedule (daily) or manual run.
1. Fetch each lender page (failures tolerated).
2. Cheap deterministic parse of data-* attributes.
3. Only if a page has no structured data -> LLM extraction (cost only where needed).
4. Validate, upsert into loan_products, deactivate products not seen for 3 days.
